customManagers.description: Creality Print release installed by the Dockerfile
Tool images the workflows run with docker run, declared as *_VERSION env vars under a `# renovate:` comment

packageRules.description: Bundle all tooling updates (GitHub Actions, Playwright, Docker CLI, ...) into one PR, at most once a week, majors included. The base image and Creality Print get their own PRs (rules below).

The Selkies base image gets its own weekly PR, on the tooling schedule: a base bump can fail the build on purpose (build/patch-selkies.sh, or the move to the Rust Selkies; docs/research/selkies-rust.md), and must not block the other tooling updates.

Creality Print releases get their own PR as soon as they appear: that's the update users notice. Track every plain vX.Y.Z release, including ones GitHub flags as prerelease (creality.com distributes those as current; docs/research/decisions.md). Suffixed tags (-Beta, -rc) are excluded.
